resume_guidance.why_it_matters: The target evaluates individual ownership of compliant operations.
resume_guidance.safe_direction: Clarify the candidate-confirmed decision, collaborators, and observable outcome.
resume_guidance.truth_boundary: Do not claim regulatory authority or outcomes not documented by the candidate.
resume_guidance.completion_check: A reviewer can separate personal ownership from team responsibility.

stop_rules: Do not add regulatory claims from target-side sources.

rounds.label: Operations leadership
rounds.purpose: Test compliant execution, escalation, and stakeholder judgment.

resources.title: FDA Bioresearch Monitoring
resources.reading_scope: Review program purpose and inspection responsibilities relevant to the target role.
resources.skip_guidance: Skip enforcement cases unrelated to the target scope.
resources.completion_condition: Explain the preparation boundary, escalation path, and one evidence-control example without claiming candidate experience.

question_bank.prompt: Describe a time you prepared an operation for external review.
question_bank.why_asked: Tests the open ownership and compliance signal.

actions.title: Build an inspection-readiness evidence brief
actions.completion_condition: Deliver a three-minute evidence-bounded answer and two follow-ups.

application_experiment.hypothesis: Clear compliance ownership improves qualified responses.
